# GSL-Lang

> A declarative graph specification language for describing directed graphs with attributes and set-based grouping. This repository contains the normative specification, reference implementation (Go), query language (GQL) extension, CLI tools, LSP server, and VS Code integration.

## Core Language

- [spec/gsl/SPEC.md](spec/gsl/SPEC.md): Normative specification for GSL v1.0 (RFC 2119)
- [spec/gsl/GRAMMAR.md](spec/gsl/GRAMMAR.md): Formal grammar (EBNF)
- [guides/GSL_GUIDE.md](guides/GSL_GUIDE.md): Self-contained GSL language guide — syntax, semantics, gotchas
- [guides/GO_REFERENCE.md](guides/GO_REFERENCE.md): Go reference implementation guide — API, patterns, algorithms

## Query Language (GQL)

- [spec/gql/QUERY_SPEC.md](spec/gql/QUERY_SPEC.md): Query language specification
- [spec/gql/QUERY_GRAMMAR.md](spec/gql/QUERY_GRAMMAR.md): Query language formal grammar
- [guides/GQL_GUIDE.md](guides/GQL_GUIDE.md): Self-contained GQL language guide
- [guides/QUERY_TUTORIAL.md](guides/QUERY_TUTORIAL.md): Step-by-step GQL learning guide
- [tests/conformance/gql/README.md](tests/conformance/gql/README.md): GQL test fixture catalog (organized learning path)

## Dialects

- [spec/dialects/DIALECTS_SPEC.md](spec/dialects/DIALECTS_SPEC.md): Normative specification for dialects — YAML documents that declare conventions and validate projected attributes with JSON Schema
- [spec/dialects/SUPPORTED_GQL_SUBSET.md](spec/dialects/SUPPORTED_GQL_SUBSET.md): The GQL subset available inside dialect match queries
- [guides/DIALECT_GUIDE.md](guides/DIALECT_GUIDE.md): Dialect authoring guide — document structure, representations, matching, GSL-to-JSON projection, and JSON Schema authoring patterns
- [examples/dialects/software-architecture/](examples/dialects/software-architecture/): End-to-end reference dialect (node, edge and set definitions) with a conforming model
- [tests/conformance/dialects/README.md](tests/conformance/dialects/README.md): Dialect conformance fixture catalog (document, matching, projection, attribute validation, outcomes)

## Getting Started

- [README.md](README.md): User-facing overview, quick start, and usage examples
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Human learning journey — Getting Started, Concepts, Tutorials, Cookbook (the route for beginner users)
- [docs/getting-started/README.md](docs/getting-started/README.md): Install tools and run the two-minute test
- [docs/concepts](docs/concepts/): The graph model in plain language — nine one-concept pages (graph-model, edges, attributes, sets, structure-and-nesting, edge-dependencies, queries-and-views, parsing-and-merging, canonical-form)
- [docs/tutorials/README.md](docs/tutorials/README.md): Modelling with GSL, the flagship examples, and the GQL learning path
- [docs/tutorials/modelling-with-gsl.md](docs/tutorials/modelling-with-gsl.md): How to decide what belongs in a model — node, edge, attribute, set, nesting, edge dependency
- [docs/cookbook/README.md](docs/cookbook/README.md): Short recipes — retire a service, team views, CI rendering, release gates
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Development guide for AI agents contributing to this repo
- [Agent skill: gsl-modelling](.agents/skills/gsl-modelling/SKILL.md): Source-faithful GSL modelling skill for agents — turns prose/reports/tickets into a faithful graph with no invented facts, edges, or conventions; carries plain copies of the repository's authoritative guides (GSL_GUIDE, GQL_GUIDE, GRAMMAR, QUERY_GRAMMAR, modelling-with-gsl), refreshed from upstream via `go test -run TestAgentSkillMirrorDrift -update ./tests`. Discovered natively by opencode, Cursor and Codex via `.agents/skills/`; Claude Code needs a `.claude/skills` pointer. Verification: `go test -v -run 'TestAgentSkill|TestSkillBehaviour' ./tests`. Behavioural fixtures: `examples/skill-behaviour/` (misleading-source smoke exercise).
- [Agent skill: gsl-dialect-authoring](.agents/skills/gsl-dialect-authoring/SKILL.md): Dialect authoring/review skill for agents — turns stated conventions into a dialect document and checks a model with `gsl-dialect`; carries plain copies of DIALECT_GUIDE, DIALECTS_SPEC and SUPPORTED_GQL_SUBSET (refreshed the same way).

## Implementation

- [Go reference implementation](implementations/go/): Core parser, lexer, AST, graph model, serializer, and the GQL library (`query/`)
- [CLI tools](cmd/): gsl-diagram (Mermaid/PlantUML), gsl-query (query runner), gsl-dialect (dialect validation)
- [LSP server](lsp/): Language server protocol implementation
- [VS Code extension](editors/vscode/): Syntax highlighting and IDE support
